head: codex/5663-runtime-v3-durable-local-adapters
title: [v0.91.8][runtime-v3][adapters] Implement durable local Runtime v3 adapters (#5663)
body:
## Summary

Implements #5663 durable local Runtime v3 adapters for Agent, Shepherd, Scheduler, Chronosense, CheckpointStore, and Lifelog. Production local adapters now perform bounded real local behavior instead of generic receipt-only success. Provider, ACIP, A2A, and Cloud Bridge remain fail-closed pending their separate external transport scopes.

- `cargo test --locked --manifest-path adl-runtime-kernel/Cargo.toml --target-dir /Volumes/FastWork/adl-wp-5663/target --test operations`
- `cargo test --locked --manifest-path adl-runtime-kernel/Cargo.toml --target-dir /Volumes/FastWork/adl-wp-5663/target --test governed_operations`
